correctness.rationale: Four i.i.d. uniform boundary-circle points yield Dirichlet(1,1,1,1) circular gaps after choosing a distinguished sampled vertex. Diagonal crossing angle T=(g1+g3)/2 has beta(2,2), and conditional gap splits are independent uniforms. Acute folding symmetry sends T↔pi−T while preserving area, giving K_t=sin(t)(cos U−cos V), U uniform(0,t) and V uniform(t,2pi−t), independent. This produces complete continuous conditional CDF via one-dimensional integral, support [0,2sin t], exact conditional mean pi sin²t/[t(pi−t)], variance and the upper-tail coefficient pi/[2t(pi−t)sin t] by a half-disk quadratic-endpoint calculation. Independently simulated 70000 conditional cosine pairs at each of four angles, checking mean/variance; derived chord-product identity independently at machine precision. Unconditional moments and angle marginal correctly marked as prior/consistency rather than originality.
